def _bridge(cal):
    raw = np.asarray(cal['bridge_raw'], dtype=float)
    loads = np.asarray(cal['true_channel_loads'], dtype=float)
    return np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack((raw, np.ones(len(raw)))), loads.sum(axis=1), rcond=None)[0]

def _features(*splits):
    x = np.concatenate([p['coupon_features_raw'] for p in splits]).astype(float)
    refs = np.concatenate([p['ref_coupons'] for p in splits])
    lab = np.concatenate([p['lab_id'] for p in splits])
    strata = np.concatenate([p['stratum'] for p in splits])
    for label in np.unique(lab):
        rows = lab == label
        panel = refs[rows]
        x[rows] = (x[rows] - np.median(panel.mean(axis=0))) / np.median(panel.std(axis=0))
    (_, cell, count) = np.unique(np.column_stack((lab, strata)), axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    weight = 1.0 / count[cell]
    valid = np.isfinite(x)
    denominator = (valid * weight[:, None]).sum(axis=0)
    means = np.divide(weight @ np.where(valid, x, 0.0), denominator, out=np.zeros(x.shape[1]), where=denominator != 0)
    return np.where(valid, x, means)

def solve_batch(dataset: dict) -> dict:
    (train, test) = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    (dt, times) = (np.asarray(dataset['past_dt']), np.asarray(dataset['eval_times']))
    bridge = _bridge(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    x = _features(train, test)
    n = len(train['lab_id'])
    (taus, theta) = _fit(_coupon(train, x[:n], bridge), dt, times, train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None], train['instant_rate_obs'])
    (curve, rate) = _design(taus, _coupon(test, x[n:], bridge), dt, times)
    return {'estimated_taus': taus, 'hereditary_weights': theta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + curve @ theta, 'initial_rate_pred': rate @ theta}
